about: Douglas C. Malek is an attorney with Malek & Malek Law Firm in Columbus, Ohio. A well-reputed trial lawyer with more than 16 years of legal experience, he provides invaluable counsel and support to clients throughout the greater Columbus metro area and across Central Ohio who are seeking their rightful workers' compensation benefits. He also handles a broad spectrum of matters related to personal injury and wrongful death claims.

Over the course of his legal career, Mr. Malek has assisted numerous injured and disabled workers in obtaining the full amount of compensation they need to support themselves and their families when they can no longer work. He has also secured substantial settlements and verdicts for individuals and families suffering needlessly due to the negligent, careless or unlawful acts of others.

At all turns, Mr. Malek delivers highly personalized counsel to his clients, and he works hard to protect their rights, preserve their entitlements and help them recover the full amount of finances they need and deserve. From his efforts, he has earned a place in the list of Top 40 Under 40 from the National Trial Lawyers and received many other top rankings and endorsements from his peers.

A 2004 graduate of Miami University in Oxford, Ohio, Mr. Malek received a scholarship to attend Cleveland State University College of Law, where he graduated in 2007 with a Juris Doctor degree. During his time in law school, he was recognized with the CALI Excellence for the Future Awards in workers’ compensation for achieving the highest score in the course. Additionally, he is an active member of the Ohio State Bar Association and the Ohio Association for Justice, among his other professional affiliations. He has also been rated “Very Good” on Avvo.
